storyTheme: Harry Potter: The Houses of Hogwarts
highlights: Slytherin won the House Cup with 58 points, edging Hufflepuff (57), Ravenclaw (55) and Gryffindor (41) in the final standings.
The company was split into the four houses of Hogwarts, with just under 30 remotes traveling in, an all-time record.
Slytherin took Midnight Club with 13 members, ahead of Ravenclaw (9), Gryffindor (8) and Hufflepuff (5).
Ravenclaw won both the Tri-Wizard Tournament (led by Ashley Schuliger) and the Battle of the Memes.
Dom Favata swept Super Smash Bros. and Mario Kart at Gaming Night, then won the Beer Pong Finals with Lucas Fernandes as The Splash Bros.
Monday through Thursday were House Days, with each house providing all three meals for House Cup points.

competitions.name: Midnight Club
competitions.description: One point per house member who works from 12:00 AM to noon Sunday; houses ranked 10 / 5 / 3 / 1.

competitions.name: Black Tuesday
competitions.description: No talking from 6:00 AM to 1:00 PM Tuesday; houses ranked 10 / 5 / 3 / 1.

competitions.name: Daily Workouts
competitions.description: One point per member completing all four workouts (2 Beast Mode, 2 Yoga); houses ranked 10 / 5 / 3 / 1.

competitions.name: Stairs Challenge
competitions.description: One point per member per day with at least 5 full trips; houses ranked 10 / 5 / 3 / 1.

competitions.name: Tri-Wizard Tournament
competitions.description: Elimination-style wizarding challenges; each house puts forth its 12 best. Points 10 / 5 / 3 / 1 by order of elimination.

competitions.name: Battle of the Memes
competitions.description: Live meme showdown at the talent show; points 10 / 5 / 3 / 1 by team voting.

competitions.name: Billable Hours
competitions.description: House War Week billable hours vs. its four-week average; 10 / 5 / 3 / 1 by percentage.

competitions.name: Spirit / Discretionary
competitions.description: JG gear, HP gear, decorations, participation, enthusiasm, meals, morning announcements and more.

competitions.name: Settlers of Catan
competitions.description: 5 House Cup points to the winner's house; 3 to the second table winner.

competitions.name: Magic the Gathering
competitions.description: 3 House Cup points for the advanced champ, 1 for the beginner champ.

competitions.name: War Week Beer & Cards
competitions.description: 3 House Cup points for the advanced champ, 1 for the beginner champ.

competitions.name: Gaming Night
competitions.description: Super Smash Bros. Ultimate, Mario Kart and CS:GO tournaments; each winner earns 3 points for their house.

competitions.name: Wizard's Chess Tournament
competitions.description: 5 / 3 / 1 House Cup points for 1st, 2nd and 3rd; 1 point to the beginners bracket winner.

awards.name: House Cup
awards.description: Highest final House Cup total: Slytherin 58, Hufflepuff 57, Ravenclaw 55, Gryffindor 41.

awards.name: Billable Hours Champ
awards.description: Ravenclaw earned the top 10 points in Billable Hours in the final standings.

awards.name: Settlers of Catan Second Table Champion
